SourceBasis: Own TDS p.2 Recommended Printing Conditions: Build Surface Material = Tempered glass, BuildTak, Carbon fiber plate. This is bed-surface advice, not filament filler. p.1 describes TPU64D but publishes no filler composition. Own TDS p.3 prints the model-drying schedule; OPEN-PROBLEMS retains its unresolved thermal-feasibility concern. Coverage wording explicitly retains that limitation without changing status.
Limitations: No unfilled assertion, zero filler content, new material identity, grade move, specimen correction or model change. Printer-bed Carbon fiber plate does not mean carbon fibre filament.

ExpectedCoverage.Finding: Reviewed 2026-10-01: Flashforge TPU 64D (G039-23) has product-specific post-processing evidence (Q05077, D-FLASH-TPU-64D-TDS-EN, p. 3: Post-processing note). Evidence scope is this product and the stated conditions; it does not establish suitability or cover every product of the material. Recommended treatment and measured specimen preparation remain distinct.

ProposedCoverage.Finding: Reviewed 2026-10-01: Flashforge TPU 64D (G039-23) has product-specific post-processing evidence (Q05077, D-FLASH-TPU-64D-TDS-EN, p. 3: Post-processing note). Evidence scope is this product and the stated conditions; it does not establish suitability or cover every product of the material. Recommended treatment and measured specimen preparation remain distinct. The published 120–130 °C / 6–8 h model-drying recommendation is already recorded as questionable in OPEN-PROBLEMS; thermal feasibility and strength improvement are not established. Evidence recorded means sourced finishing guidance exists, not a validated safe treatment.
